description:
## Son sürümden beri değişiklikler

Önceki sürümden beri değişiklik yok.

**Tam karşılaştırma:** https://github.com/MrRaita/Karma-Patches/compare/v1.0.1-dev.1...v1.0.1

patches.name: Keep player controls during live ads
patches.description: Stops the app from hiding the player controls when a live ad starts, so you can seek past it.

patches.name: Live stream without ad insertion (experimental)
patches.description: Bypasses DAION and plays the plain live URL. May not work if the server rejects it.

patches.name: Remove banner ads
patches.description: Removes Google Ad Manager banners across the NOW app.

patches.name: Remove video ads
patches.description: Disables IMA/VMAP pre-roll and mid-roll ads in on-demand videos.
